records.managing_agency: Marin Water (Marin Municipal Water District)
records.fishing_notes: Largest Mt. Tam watershed reservoir; largemouth/smallmouth bass and trout; shore fishing, no boats or wading (Marin Water rules; Wikipedia)

Bait (9.06.03): no aquatic life, living or dead, except salmon eggs and worms. Dogs leashed (6 ft max) and may not enter the water (9.05.01). Streams: 'Lagunitas Creek, between Alpine and Kent Lake, is open for fishing from the last Saturday in April through November 15'; 'All other streams on Marin Water lands are closed to all fishing, all year.' State CDFW limits apply; no district bag limits published.
